title: pouteria polita
intro: Pouteria polita, commonly known as the White Milingo or White Milingo Tree, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Pouteria polita is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiviral, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria polita include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
